record.evidence_quote: The minimum value of 0.56 eV activation energy is associated with the highest conductivity value of 7.23 x 10-6 S/cm at room temperature.
record.notes: Composition is Li7-4xGexLa3Zr2O12 with x=0.10, written in the paper as Li6.6Ge0.1La3Zr2O12. Sintering time is given as 7.30 h. Relative density 86.44% is from Table 1 (x=0.10 row; the row is split in the PDF text). Activation energy 0.56 eV is stated for this sample in the abstract and Section 3.4.2. Table 2 lists bulk conductivities for x=0, 0.05, 0.15, 0.20 at 25 C, but the PDF table layout does not clearly align values with rows, so those are not recorded. Measurement at 25 C is given as 'room temperature'. Conductivity kind is unspecified in the text, though Table 2 labels it sigma_bulk.
